'''Town Gratitude''' is an item that grants {{Item|Happiness|5}} when consumed.

Happiness can never exceed {{Item|Town Quality}}. Any excess Happiness is lost.

== Obtaining ==

* Buy from [[Januarius]].
* Reward from [[quests]].
* Reward from [[Town Battles|battles]].
